name: example-class-split-demo
description: ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLE ONLY - not a recommendation. Values are chosen to straddle the observed soak plateaus so the tool's behaviour is visible; they are derived from no limit or safety analysis. Package and hottest-channel VRAM are separate classes with separate warning/critical values (package 65/75, VRAM 78/88), to show how the classes behave differently. Instantaneous, no hysteresis.
